text: If it is objected that even in such a case, according to that view, the doubt of irregularity is difficult to remove, we do not agree. This is because the doubt that an effect arises without a cause is removed by the fact that it is limited by the period of conflict. For, one would doubt precisely that in which, if one did not doubt, the conflict and the like would not arise. It has been stated: “The doubt of conflict and the like” (Nyāya-kusumāñjali, Sūtra 3/7).
